sam.title: The Sam Website
sam.description: An informative website that helps students and their parents with the transfer to high school in Belgium. A project for the CLB (Centrum voor Leerlingenbegeleiding) of West Flanders.

molQuiz.title: The Mol Quiz
molQuiz.description: A Webapp and api where friends and family could test their knowledge of the popular Belgian TV show "De Mol" after every weekly episode.

defcon.title: Defcon IoT Escape Room
defcon.description: An IoT escape room where players solve puzzles to save the world from the Soviet Union during the Cold War. The game is played in a real room with physical devices and a web interface.

whiskerWings.title: Whisker Wings
whiskerWings.description: A 3D browser game where you fly a plane operated by a bunny. The goal is to collect all rings as fast as possible. Without crashing of course.

isometricRoom.title: Isometric Castle Room
isometricRoom.description: An isometric 3D room built with Three.js. Explore the room, interact with Points of Interest and explore the small story.

devQuiz.title: Dev Quiz
devQuiz.description: A quiz application built with Vanilla TypeScript. Test your knowledge on various development topics.

laura.title: Laura's Portfolio
laura.description: A personal portfolio i built for my girlfriend. Showcasing her design projects. This website makes use of the Contentful CMS so she can manage the content herself.
